values.note: Rates from 10/1/26: 30 A water/electric pull-through or back-in $62.30, 30 A water/electric back-in waterfront $68, full-hookup pull-throughs $67 (30 A) and $71 (50 A), premium 50 A concrete pad $77; tent sites $35-40. Plus 12% SC and Charleston County tax; rates cover 4 adults and 2 children, $5 per extra person (6 max). $3 processing fee per reservation.

values.note: Two dump stations; swimming pool; stocked private lake (catch and release); propane for motorhomes by appointment.
